capabilities.title: Core build runtime
capabilities.guidance: Review affected stages and run their regression checks; path changes alone do not prove a bug fix.

capabilities.title: Semantic field planning
capabilities.guidance: Review mandatory planning and metadata gates before the next affected build.

capabilities.title: Runtime contract compatibility
capabilities.guidance: Compare contract versions and review migration requirements; do not assume compatibility.

capabilities.title: Requirement-backed HTML reports
capabilities.guidance: Review approved report definitions, mappings, supported calculations and placement verification.

capabilities.title: Native charts and dashboards
capabilities.guidance: Review chart/dashboard definitions and native reporting selections.

capabilities.title: Second-pass form formatting
capabilities.guidance: Optional: preview wizard-owned Main forms and obtain the required plan-hash approval.

capabilities.title: Power Apps view grids
capabilities.guidance: Optional: use the maker handoff and verify exported metadata; this is not automatic grid deployment.

capabilities.title: Choice presentation
capabilities.guidance: Optional: preview Choice labels/colors and obtain the required plan-hash approval.

capabilities.title: FAST planning and readiness
capabilities.guidance: Default-off planning/readiness only. Recommendations never authorize FAST-dependent Apply or deployment.

capabilities.title: Guides and authoring instructions
capabilities.guidance: Review relevant guidance; documentation changes are not deployment instructions or approval.

capabilities.title: Validation and CI
capabilities.guidance: Review validation changes and run the applicable checks before adopting runtime changes.
